review_candidates.description: Allround System Engineer Bij ConXioN zoeken we een Allround System Engineer die graag afwisseling heeft in zijn job en energie haalt uit verschillende klantenomgevingen. Je werkt met een brede waaier aan technologieën en krijgt de ruimte om zelf het verschil te maken, zonder er alleen voor te staan. Je maakt deel uit van een hecht team waar collega’s elkaar ondersteunen, kennis delen en ook naast het werk goed met elkaar kunnen opschieten. Gemiddeld werk je 2-3 dagen per week in-house bij klanten. Daar help je mee richting geven aan hun IT-omgeving en los je onsite technische uitdagingen op. Op de andere dagen werk je vanuit ons hoofdkantoor, van thuis of ben je ingepland voor incidenten, waardoor je een gezonde mix hebt tussen klantencontact, teamwerking en flexibiliteit. Jouw day-to-day als Allround System Engineer: On-site support: van installatie van laptops tot dagelijkse gebruikersondersteuning. System administration binnen uiteenlopende IT-omgevingen. Network administration en het beheer van netwerkinfrastructuur. Beheer en onderhoud van servers, storage en netwerkhardware. Je werkt steeds met security in het achterhoofd en houdt rekening met risico’s, best practices en veilige configuraties. Heb je interesse in hardware en storage? Dan krijg je op termijn de kans om hierin een voortrekkersrol op te nemen en door te groeien naar een techlead-functie. Signaleren en oplossen van technische problemen, met oog voor de noden van de klant. IT's a match? 💙 Je hebt relevante ervaring opgedaan in een IT-omgeving als System Engineer, Hardware Engineer of een gelijkaardige rol. Je hebt kennis van het Microsoft-ecosysteem en bent vertrouwd met hardware: laptops, desktops, printers, servers, netwerk- en storage-apparatuur. Je hebt een brede kijk op security (XDR, firewalls, Defender, e.d.) Ervaring met technologieën en tools zoals VMware, Fortinet, HPE, Dell en Cisco is een sterke troef. Je werkt graag autonoom en kan jezelf snel aanpassen aan nieuwe omgevingen. Waarom werken bij ConXioN? 🌿Wees welkom op onze ConXioN Campus! Een werkplek om te focussen, samen te werken aan dezelfde visie en elkaar te ontmoeten. Met stille focusruimtes en levendige sociale hubs: voor ieder wat wils!  Ontspan tijdens jouw pauze in ons buitenterras met veel groen, onze belevingsruimte met dartsbord, pooltafel en bar, en onze bedrijfsfitness!  💙 Connected at heart: bij ConXioN heb je de kans om met collega's te werken die elkaar kennen en versterken. We zetten in op ambiance en teamspirit, door onze afterworks, teambuildings en andere initiatieven van onze collega's. Elke week heb je de kans om jouw collega's beter te leren kennen tijdens de wekelijkse afsluit op vrijdagen!   🚀 Opleiding en groei: wij zetten in op kennisdeling, opleiding en groei. Je krijgt een persoonlijk en doelgericht traject en de kans om opleidingen te volgen en certificaten te halen.   ⚖️ Een werkplek in balans: door hybride werkmogelijkheden en glijdende uren, bieden we de mogelijkheid om jouw werkleven in balans te brengen met jouw persoonlijke situatie.   🔁 Verloning op maat: We zorgen voor een sterk en eerlijk loonpakket, afgestemd op jouw ervaring en de impact die je maakt. Je kan rekenen op extralegale voordelen als:  Bedrijfswagen of mobiliteitsbudget  Maaltijdcheques van 8 euro per gewerkte dag  Ecocheques van 250 euro pro rata per jaar  Hospitalisatieverzekering via Alan, jouw all-in-one health partner  Ons cafetariaplan waar je jouw eindejaarspremie op een flexibele manier kunt inzetten, zoals een fietsleasing, extra vakantiedagen, thuiswerkmateriaal, of een combinatie van meerdere dingen!  Een 39-uren werkweek met 6 ADV-dagen.

review_candidates.title: 10778 - Sr. Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: 10778 - Sr. Network Engineer Irvine, CA 92614 (5 days on-site) Company Overview Hyundai AutoEver America (HAEA) is the dynamic IT powerhouse behind Hyundai Motor Corporation, a Fortune 500 global leader in the automotive industry. As a key affiliate, we provide cutting-edge IT services and support to top brands including Kia, Genesis, Hyundai Translead, Hyundai Mobis, Hyundai Capital, and Glovis. HAEA offers a truly global and collaborative environment. Here, you’ll drive innovation, boost operational efficiency, and help shape the future of mobility for the Hyundai Motor Group. At HAEA, we understand that IT is the cornerstone of today’s fast-evolving digital world. By uniting all IT resources under one roof, we deliver consistent, top-quality solutions while serving as the crucial information link between Hyundai’s Global Headquarters and North American operations. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make a real impact at a world-class company, Hyundai AutoEver America is the place to grow your career. Join us and be part of the transformation that’s driving the future of automotive innovation. Website: http://www.haeaus.com Role Overview: Ensures Service Provider delivery of managed services in the areas of Network Services functions meet HAEA’s Network & Business requirements. This position requires in-depth knowledge of HAEA’s Network Infrastructure, (LAN/Switches, DNS – DHCP, WAN, Load Balancers, VOIP, VPN etc.) to address complex incidents and problems and to provide a stable and reliable infrastructure. This position is also responsible for ensuring that Network Infrastructure meets availability requirements and contracted service levels. The person is also responsible for managing vendor technical performance, network specific contracts/suppliers and prioritizing customer business requests, managing projects schedules and budgets. Key Responsibilities: Develop and provide Network architecture Provide Network documentation standards and requirements Develop business and functional requirements for Projects relating to the Network Management Services Manage circuit provisioning for new WAN connectivity, including obtaining favorable circuit pricing Work with Client’s facility personnel to build necessary facility requirements Order and expedite delivery of Network equipment, circuits and services Manage the performance of public carriers (and other third parties) to meet Client requirements (e.g., schedules, projects) and SLAs Coordinate and oversee third-party installation activities (e.g., Network carrier circuit installation activities, router installation) Approve router configuration files and IP addressing schemas and standards Provide requirements (e.g., security, performance) for physical and logical Network traffic segmentation Manage technical third-party relationships for facility cable management services (e.g., physical wiring between servers and wiring closet and between wiring closet and desktop) Support activities related to Client-planned or third-party planned and unplanned outages Monitoring Service Provider’s end-to-end support of Network Services Managing Service Provider overall performance & SLAs and quality in accordance with contract Ensuring that Patch Monitoring and Deployments are performed timely and in accordance with service levels. Providing on-site support to compliment service provider’s remote management services. Overseeing infrastructure hardware and software acquisition, installation, and changes. Ensuring high availability of infrastructure via service level management. Ensuring that Incident Management and upgrades are resolved. Identifying change requests in lieu of performance improvements and cost efficiencies. Basic Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in the field of business, computers, information systems or related degree. 10-12 years relevant work experience in related functional role. Extensive knowledge of networking technologies and protocols including TCP/IP, QoS, IPT, VoIP, IOS; Routing and Switching; Routing protocols such as OSPF and BGP; WAN Optimization technologies Demonstrated experience Wired and wireless local area network (“LAN”) segments including wired and wireless infrastructure supporting all Network traffic originating from computing devices (e.g., wireless access points, desktop devices, local file and print servers, peripherals and other Network devices and other End User devices) Demonstrated experience with setup and configuration of redundant networking environments. Demonstrated ability to manage IP management components – Domain Name Services (DNS) and Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) components and central, real-time logging components Experience in Remote access components – Virtual private network (“VPN”) infrastructure Firewalls, Multi-factor authentication Equipment and Software (e.g., tokens), Intrusion prevention and detection devices Deep knowledge in designing and developing functional SDN and SDDC technology, understanding of security, physical networking is required Expertise in Network Components provisioned are included in all IT Life Cycle and IT Service Management Services-related documentation (e.g., asset management and configuration management, i.e. CMDB) Preferred Qualifications Ability to design processes that ensure rapid Incident determination, alert identification and correlation, escalation and resolution for all Network environments on a 24x7x365 Demonstrated experience with continuous improvements to Networking Solutions Remote access components – Virtual private network (“VPN”) infrastructure. Extensive experience with Networking problem diagnosis and resolution. Demonstrated experience with server administration. Experience in managing sourcing vendors, deliverables and service delivery outcomes. Preferred experience in managing enterprise network management SLA/service delivery metrics. Experience overseeing root cause analysis to proactively prevent problem recurrence and to improve Service Levels. Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice . Team Culture: Our team thrives on collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning. We foster a supportive environment where every member is encouraged to share ideas and contribute to problem-solving. We value: Passion for Technology: We are enthusiastic about emerging technologies and their potential to transform the automotive industry. Agility: We work in an agile environment, adapting quickly to changes and continuously improving our processes. Teamwork: We believe in the power of teamwork and collaboration, supporting each other to achieve common goals. Growth: We prioritize personal and professional growth, offering opportunities for learning and development. Inclusivity: We maintain an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone feels welcome. Salary Range: $135,000 - $150,000 Our Company adheres to the equal employment opportunity guidelines set forth by federal, state and local laws. The information requested on this form is sought in good faith and will not be used to discriminate against the applicant based on race, religion or creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic characteristics, marital status, sex or gender (which includes pregnancy, childbirth, or related circumstances), gender identity, gender expression, age, citizenship, sexual orientation, family care or medical leave status, military and veteran status, political affiliation, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state and local laws.

review_candidates.title: Information Technology Manager
review_candidates.description: Internal IT Manager (f/m/d) What you'll be working on Own day-to-day IT operations for roughly 120 users/endpoints across our local site(s): Microsoft 365, endpoints, and office network infrastructure. Administer and continuously improve our Microsoft 365 environment (Entra ID, Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams). Implement security best practices: MFA/Conditional Access, least privilege, endpoint hardening, patching, and access reviews. Handle incidents and service requests efficiently: triage, troubleshooting, documentation, and follow-up to prevent recurrence. Roll out and maintain tools and applications, including SaaS tools (packaging, deployment, updates, licensing, access management). Support users with device and software setup (primarily Windows 11; also macOS/Linux as needed). Occasionally disassemble/reassemble devices for upgrades and repairs. Collaborate closely with the central IT team on purchasing, standards, and platform changes. What your bring Relevant education in the field or equivalent hands-on experience, e.g. Microsoft certifications. 3+ years of IT administration experience with a strong focus on end-user support. Solid Windows client administration skills. Experience with macOS and Linux is a plus. Comfortable with scripting/automation. PowerShell and/or Bash/Python are a plus. Good understanding of networking fundamentals such as DNS/DHCP, VLAN/Wi-Fi, VPN/firewalls basics. Structured, reliable, and service-oriented mentality as well as being able to work independently and prioritize effectively. Written and spoken language skills in English and German. Interest and experience in modern automation and AI-assisted IT tooling. Nice to have's Experience with identity and access governance and security operations. Experience with blue teaming / SOC environments and tooling, e.g. FleetDM, Wazuh, Greenbone. Familiarity with tools like 1Password, Slack, YouTrack, and Claude (or comparable alternatives). Interest in e-mobility and battery technology. What we offer You’ll be the first dedicated person for this field at AVILOO. You’ll drive global IT-set up initiatives and are our go-to-expert. An innovative, performance- and team-oriented work environment where success is celebrated together. Creative freedom in a company that is set to increase its revenue significantly in the coming years. A workplace with a true start-up mentality, flat hierarchies, and fast decision-making. AI is at the core of how we work and how we think about the future of our processes. We're looking for people who are genuinely excited about that - not just comfortable using AI tools but interested in what becomes possible when you build around them. Reliable work-life balance - personally guaranteed by the CEO. About us AVILOO is the world's leading EV battery data expert and has developed the world's first independent State-of-Health test for electric vehicle batteries. Since its founding in 2018, we have grown into the global market leader in independent EV battery diagnostics. With locations in Europe, Asia, Australia, and the USA, our clients include renowned testing organizations, leasing companies, vehicle dealers, and automobile clubs. We are a fast-growing tech company that values innovation, collaboration, and an entrepreneurial mindset. And that’s exactly why we are looking for you — who thinks ahead, helps shape things and grows with us. If you prefer real conversations, quick decisions and shared breaks, you’ll fit right in. We are not a company of buzzwords or fads. We stand for performance, pragmatism and common sense — with a dash of humour and genuine team energy. What counts here is what you can do and how you contribute. “We take care of our people. While performance is important to us, we also ensure a good work–life balance. As a father of five, I know that parents in particular need flexibility. I guarantee that flexibility to you!” — Dr. Marcus Berger, CEO Sounds like you? Want to be right in the middle of it? Then send us your application documents. We will get back to you reliably! We look forward to getting to know you! AVILOO GmbH IZ NÖ Süd, Straße 16, Objekt 69, 2355 Wiener Neudorf www.aviloo.com/en/jobs-company
